name: Jorge Martín Frías - Proposition de résolution de remplacement - Am 1
title: REPORT on access to finance for SMEs and scale-ups
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its opinion on how to help small and medium-sized businesses and fast-growing young companies get funding. It asks the European Commission to cut paperwork and rules that weigh on smaller firms, to help household savings and pension money flow into businesses, and to close the gap in late-stage growth funding so companies stay and grow in Europe. It is not a law; it is a set of recommendations.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only recommends; new laws would need Commission proposals.
- **Who it affects:** Small and medium businesses, start-ups, banks, investors and savers across the EU.
- **What happens next:** The resolution goes to the Council and Commission, which decide whether to act on it.
